text:
Operating Budget

The Baseline includes no funding in FY 2027 for the operating budget. This amount is unchanged from FY 2026.

The Baseline includes no new funding for the Independent Redistricting Commission (IRC) in FY 2027 and subsequent years given that the Commission has completed its constitutional duties for the 10-year redistricting cycle that began in CY 2020 and has no outstanding litigation. The Commission approved the current redistricting maps in December 2021.

For the CY 2020 redistricting cycle, the IRC received a total of \$8,400,000 in appropriations from the General Fund as shown in Table 1. (See the FY 2023 Appropriations Report for background on the CY 2010 redistricting cycle funding.) These monies paid for the operational costs of the IRC as well as funding the staff, legal counsel, and vendors that provided technical and administrative support for the Commission's redistricting duties.

A FY 2025 General Appropriations Act footnote required monies remaining in the appropriation made in Laws 2021, Chapter 408 as of June 30, 2024 revert to the General Fund. Through June 2026, the Commission has expended \$8,386,300 of the \$8,400,000 in funding for the CY 2020 redistricting cycle.

The agency does not maintain a permanent staff. New commissioners will begin the next redistricting process in CY 2030.
